body.summary: Added LockManager.request for grants that need no wait: inside the name's mutex, exclusive is granted only when the lock word is 0 and shared only when it is >= 0 with no exclusive waiting; the holder slot is claimed by CAS (0 -> -(threadId + 1), so the main thread's claim is -1 as the plan states and a worker's claim names it for reclaim), filled and published last; a full holder table gives the lock word back. Release runs in finally. ifAvailable returns callback(null, blockedBy) with holders and pending exclusives. An AsyncLocalStorage set of held names refuses same-name and unbounded nested requests. setLockGrantHookForTests runs at three grant points. A waiting request (not ifAvailable, lock unavailable) throws until t3 adds the waiting path.
